description: Renovate is the sole dependency manager for this repo. Dependabot is NOT used — Renovate covers Go modules, GitHub Actions, and Node.js (semantic-release plugins).

Hold conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits below v10: v10 replaced Handlebars templates with render functions and requires conventional-changelog-writer 9, but @semantic-release/release-notes-generator 14.x and @semantic-release/commit-analyzer 13.x still depend on conventional-changelog-writer ^8 (release fails with 'requires conventional-changelog-writer@9 or newer'). Remove once release-notes-generator supports writer 9. See https://github.com/gjed/github-activity-exporter/issues/65

Hold github.com/prometheus/common below v0.73.0: v0.73.0 (https://github.com/prometheus/common/pull/1008) takes the escaping scheme only from the Accept clause that matched, and expfmt negotiates only Prometheus text 0.0.4, so the Prometheus 3.x default scrape (text/plain;version=1.0.0;escaping=allow-utf-8) gets escaping=underscores and /metrics serves github_pr_count instead of github.pr.count. Remove once text format 1.0.0 negotiation lands upstream: https://github.com/prometheus/common/pull/1035, tracked in https://github.com/gjed/github-activity-exporter/issues/109. This rule only limits direct proposals: a client_golang or otel/exporters/prometheus release requiring common >= v0.73.0 still raises it transitively (MVS), and the Integration Test live-check on /metrics is the guard against that.
Never automerge major updates of the release toolchain: CI does not exercise semantic-release on PRs, so a breaking major only fails in release.yml after merge (see #65).
